data.message: I commit to 18 this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose18 and the rest10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next is500 or100. This is risky, not a guaranteed long-run gain; other catches need recalculation and intentions aren't binding. Each: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional on others?
